full_judgment: 2. The facts of the case are that on 26.9.82 plaintiff opposite parties filed a petition under Section 92 of the Code of Civil Procedure in the Court of the District Judge, Chittagong stating that the properties described in Schedule Nos. 1 and 2 situated in Mouza Imamganj, P.S. Kotwali, District Chittagong total area Measuring, 3481 acres was owned and possessed by the public deity Sree Sree Nara Singha. In the R,S. Khatian in respect of Schedules 1 and 2 property the name of Shebayet Rameswar Das has been recorded. The devoted Hindu public of Chittagong used to visit said Narasingha temple and worship the deity from time immemorial. The properties of the deity were treated as public deity properties from long before the R.S, operation. The Shebait had no personal interest in the property of the deity. All the properties of the deity have. been managed by the Shebait. The recorded Shebait Ramseur Das left the country with the partition of this Sub. Continent and one Sarada Charan Chakraborty got his name recorded in P.S. Khatian as Shebait of the said Public deity. After the departure of Sarada Charan Chakra barty the then religious minded people of Chittagong appointed defendant No. 1 Sunil Kumar Bbattacharjee as 'pujari' of the deity and entrusted him with the seba puja, bhog and Atari of the deity. They also entrusted him with the management of the deity's properties. The plaintiffs are the worshippers and devotees of the said deity from the time of their ancestors and vitally interested in the property of the deity and management thereof. The defendant No. 1 pojari has let out some portion of the deity's property and permitted some of them to make pucca constructions and has been realising rents. The defendant No. 1 has been misappropriating the whole income of the deity's property and is not performing Seba, Puja, Bhog and Arati of the deity in the proper manner. He has also not made any work for the development and betterment of the deity and deity's property. The Hindu devotees of the locality demanded the accounts of the expenditures from defendant No. 1 who did not submit the same. The defendant No. 1 has realised huge amount of money from defendant No. 20 and is trying to sell, deity's properties to him and other persons. Defendant No. 1 got a portion of deity's property declared as vested property and has applied for the lease of the said property. The activities of the defendant No. 1 are Prejudicial to the deity. The cause of action arose. last on 15.9.82 when the plaintiff demanded account from the defendant No. 3 who refused to give the same. The plaintiff prayed before the Deputy Commissioner, Chittagong for granting them leave to file suit for removal of the said defendant No. 1 from the office of Shebait of the deity Sree Sree Narisingha Bigraha and to direct the defendant. No. 1 to submit account of the properties and to appoint another person as Shebait or Pujari of the deity.
